status: two findings classified reported; remaining candidates classified

findings.issue: skip_ie() reads ies[pos+1] length byte whenever pos < ielen (pos == ielen-1 passes caller check), one-byte OOB; loop advances by 2+len without validating pos+1 < ielen or pos+2+len <= ielen; skip_ie return can exceed ielen, causing ieee80211_ie_split_ric to return pos > ielen, then mlme.c:2372 skb_put_data(skb, assoc_data->ie + offset, noffset - offset) copies past the user-supplied assoc IE buffer

eir_get_service_data() reads get_unaligned_le16(eir) on returned data pointer without ensuring dlen >= 2 (EIR field_len==2 gives dlen==1), two-byte OOB read of remotely controlled periodic advertising data; also eir_len -= dlen underflows when dlen==eir_len (loop termination then relies on eir_get_data eir_len<2 check)

candidates_classified.reason: same ies[pos+1] OOB when pos==ielen-1 exists but callers (mesh.c:362, mlme.c:2369) pass offset 0 derived from user-set IEs later re-appended to skb; risk of copying OOB bytes into transmitted frames is lower; primary split_ric path reported separately
explicit 'if (len < 2) return -EILSEQ' before length read and iedatalen+2 > len check; inner attr loop checks iedatalen < 3
_max_length checks before bitmap reads and after each _arg advance; vendor ns length bounded by -EINVAL check

reads only eir[0] (field_len) within bounds; no second-byte read
